name: Hetzner Server
description: Host Recursive on a Hetzner Cloud server that joins your Tailscale network. Nothing on it is open to the internet.

provider.label: Hetzner Cloud
provider.description: An always-on Hetzner server from about €4 a month, private to your tailnet.

schema.label: Hetzner API token
schema.description: Read & Write token from your Hetzner Cloud project (Security → API tokens).

schema.label: Tailscale auth key
schema.description: A reusable or one-off key from the Tailscale admin console (Settings → Keys). The server joins your tailnet with it; this computer must be on the same tailnet.
